description:
Given a Sentry issue URL, fetch it via the Sentry MCP, extract stacktrace + tags + relevant frames, grep the repo for referenced file:line, and propose a concrete fix + PR title. Nimbus incident-response accelerator.
Trigger this skill when: - User pastes a `*.sentry.io/issues/…` URL. - User says "triage this Sentry issue", "check this Sentry", or invokes
  `/sentry-triage`.
- User says "look at ECG-DJANGO-BACKEND-9HX" (issue short ID).
